loan_candidates.note: loan_class 'auto': in stock in a store of the iteration and replacement under limit_clp, so it may be lent (one deck only). 'evaluate': replacement at or over limit_clp, or no stock in the iteration's stores (the replacement must wait for a restock): a builder may propose it only with a written justification of the need, the replacement situation and a fallback card, and the owner accepts or rejects it. Stock and prices as read on the date above.

iteration.name: Phase 2 (iteration 2)
iteration.budget_note: Owner, 2026-10-31: up to 10,000 CLP in total to buy cards for the optimization of the four decks, only in the stores of this iteration. It is the budget of this run and has nothing to do with the loans.
iteration.deck_caps_note: Owner 2026-11-02: the Spanish deck may use up to 5,000 CLP of the 10,000; the bilingual decks share the rest, ranked by impact.
iteration.second_store_note: Owner 2026-11-07: stores chosen after the live reading of ten stores (data/prices/*20261107*): Game of Magic Singles (main), PayToWin (the only store with Overpowering Attack and Hidden Footblade) and Tienda La Comarca (Relic of Legends in Spanish for Kilo). The 10,000 CLP are only for deck upgrades; loans, full-art basics, stock cards and extras are separate, line by line. The real Ezio waits for the normal printing to be restocked. Changed 2026-11-08: Rivendel El Concilio replaces Tienda La Comarca (it has Meticulous Excavation in Spanish, which completes Kilo's main combo, and cheaper Spanish Volt Charge and Prophetic Prism; reading data/prices/rivendel-20261108.psv).
iteration.salt_floors_note: Owner 2026-11-07, after the step-5 scores (Toph 6.9, Azula 7.0, Ezio 5.4, Kilo 3.9): Salt is secondary; scores may drop as long as the fixes remove what keeps the decks from winning. Goal: consistent, robust and as powerful as possible, as the greatest Commander champion of all time would build them with the same budgets and goals. Floors raised 2026-11-08: Azula 7.0, Toph 7.0, Ezio 6.5 (the owner would like 7.0, but power and consistency come first), Kilo 4.5. A floor must be met, yet it stays secondary: a deck under its floor may stay as built when Claude can argue it is as powerful as possible and its real power is above what Salt shows; the owner then decides the exception.

loan_rules: decks/phase2/loans.md: a loan goes to one deck only; it is allowed only if a store of the current iteration (iteration.stores) has it in stock so it can be replaced; the replacement must cost under 5,000 CLP, and a dearer card only if it is indispensable, with a written justification and its price for the owner to decide.
